name: Jacob Steeves
title: RT by @const_reborn: New Quantization Service TPN Bench now offers a full Model Quantization Toolkit, which includes methods like I-matrix and Quantization-Aware Distillation. Here's how it works: Users can upload any Hugging Face model and select the quantizations they want; TPN Bench will generate those quantizations, upload them to a bucket, and then send back the links to those quants. It can also upload them to Hugging Face if given access to it. Choose between regular quantization, I-matrix, or more advanced techniques like quantization-aware distillation, which require heavy infrastructure that we run for you. Simplify the whole quantization model pipeline with TPN Bench! 🔗 https://bench.trueperformancenetwork.com/
